articles.summary: To kick off Mother's May (our celebration of moms all month-long!) read what 13 busy mamas have to say about why LUS is their go-to when it comes to low-maintenance hair for moms—without ever compromising on the curl results they want.
articles.title: Low Maintenance Hair For Moms: 13 Busy Mamas Tell Us Why They Love LUS (Love Ur Self)
